title: shell command exits non-zero
notes: Wrapped as 'prog.pdl:1 - Shell Code error: ValueError(...)'. The command's own stderr ('boom') is printed separately, above and unconnected to the diagnostic, so the two halves of the story arrive as two unrelated messages. The line was `:0` until phase-3 item 0: the block is the whole program, whose path is empty, and `get_line` returned a literal 0 for it. It now resolves to the root node's own mark. Location stays 1 through phase-3 item 7 as well, and this golden does not move at all: the path is `[]`, so there is nothing to render. A single-block program is the one shape a block path cannot help, and three other entries share it (E-RUNTIME-001, E-RUNTIME-004, E-RUNTIME-011). The column is now rendered and this entry does **not** move: that earlier note was wrong about it. `prog.pdl:1:1` is the root mapping, and the thing that exited 7 is the shell command on file line 3, inside the `code:` scalar -- so the line is coarse by INVENTORY 7.9's test and rubric item 1 requires an *accurate* line before a second coordinate counts. Compare `E-RUNTIME-004`, which the column did move: there the offending value is the whole value of the entry the header names. What would move this entry is a finer element -- the command's own position inside the block -- not a finer coordinate on the block.
